Description:
A package for the analysis of methylation enrichment
sequencing data (e.g. MBD-seq or MEDIP-seq). This allows for
the window-based evaluation of methylation levels (using the
'qsea' package), including functions for determining
differentially methylated regions. Many functions are provided
for tidyverse style modification of the qseaSet objects
originally defined in 'qsea'.
biocViews:
Sequencing, DNAMethylation, CpGIsland, Preprocessing,
Normalization, QualityControl, Visualization,
CopyNumberVariation, DifferentialMethylation, Coverage,
ChIPSeq, ChipOnChip
